beats.en: Navya saw a red postbox on the corner and Dada ji told her that he used to write letters to his brother who studied in another city. The letter is dropped into the postbox, then the postman takes it to the post office.
beats.speakEn: Navya saw a red postbox on the corner and Dada ji told her that he used to write letters to his brother who studied in another city. The letter is dropped into the postbox, then the postman takes it to the post office.

beats.en: Long ago people communicated using drumbeats and carvings on rocks. Later, letters were carried by messengers and even pigeons, and much later the postal service started.

beats.en: From the bus Navya saw a metro train racing by, and Dada ji said metro trains travel very fast. High roads called flyovers help vehicles go above busy roads and crossings, so they save travellers' time.
